blocks.content: GA Workplace Full-Feature are enclosed in a sound-insulated bodywork. The compressors are controlled by the Atlas Copco Elektronikon® regulator. The electronic control module is fitted to the door on the right side.An electric cabinet comprising the motor starter is located behind this panel. They are provided with an air dryer. The condensate is automatically drained.The dryer is integrated in the sound-insulated body work. The dryer removes water from the compressed air by cooling the air to near freezing point.
